about: Capability registry: what the studio can use, how mature it is, what it is for. Read by lib/capabilities.mjs and `node studio.mjs`. Maturity: CORE (stable default) > PRODUCTION (tests + several films) > PROVEN (one film or a passing study) > EXPERIMENTAL (study only) > PLANNED (decided, not built) > LEARN (study its ideas; no dependency). Add a capability only with a check and, from EXPERIMENTAL up, a study.

core.about: Required for every film: Node >= 22, Chrome/Chromium, FFmpeg + ffprobe. Install manually.

vision.about: Reference forensics: shot detection, optical flow, easing curves.

audio.about: Music analysis: tempo, beats, key, sections.

live.about: Real footage of people: mattes, tracking, VAD, speech. Then download models: python tools/live.py models (~1.4 GB).

gpu.about: Browser 3D and GPU 2D engines, vendored into studio/vendor (git-ignored), pinned.

physics.about: Rigid-body bake. @dimforge/rapier3d-compat 0.21.0 (Apache-2.0), WASM inlined, into studio/vendor (git-ignored). Fixed step, interpolation, auto colliders and sleeping follow pmndrs/react-three-rapier (MIT); this is not a React port.

covers.about: Title cards and thumbnails. Satori and resvg, both MPL-2.0, installed unmodified into studio/vendor (MPL file-level copyleft is not triggered).

color.about: Professional color/image libraries for a future EXR/OCIO route. Installed tools only; no studio adapter yet.

pro.about: External desktop applications. Never auto-downloaded; install from the official site when a film needs them.

whisper.about: Optional local captions (lib/whisper.mjs). setup does not install packages and does not download models. No cloud API.
manual: whisper.cpp (MIT): git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp && cmake -B build && cmake --build build -j --config Release. Binary: build/bin/whisper-cli (older trees: main). Model: sh models/download-ggml-model.sh small — tiny 75 MiB, base 142 MiB, small 466 MiB, medium 1.5 GiB, large-v3 2.9 GiB, large-v3-turbo 1.5 GiB. Set WHISPER_MODEL to that .bin file.

faster-whisper (MIT): python3 -m pip install faster-whisper. Download yourself: hf download Systran/faster-whisper-small --local-dir studio/models/faster-whisper-small (small is a few hundred MB; large-v3 is about 3 GB). Set FASTER_WHISPER_MODEL to that folder. The captions command uses local_files_only and will not download.

sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0 runtime, Whisper weights MIT): python3 -m pip install sherpa-onnx onnxruntime soundfile && python3 tools/live.py models --asr=turbo (hundreds of MB; the full live model set is about 1.4 GB). Also --asr=base or --asr=small.

capabilities.name: Native composer: DOM + SVG + CSS
capabilities.bestFor: typography (Arabic shaping), UI, product stills, logos, layouts, layered 2.5D

capabilities.name: Canvas 2D in the composer
capabilities.bestFor: seeded particle fields up to a few thousand, procedural textures, grids
capabilities.avoidFor: text that must be read back (use .line/.word DOM)

capabilities.name: PixiJS 8 (GPU 2D)
capabilities.bestFor: tens of thousands of sprites/particles, 2D filters
capabilities.avoidFor: readable text and simple layouts (DOM is simpler)
capabilities.note: import from 'pixi.js' (composer import map). Study: 20,000 particles, identical pixels across separate runs (2026-10-03). Needs config.gpu: true; await app.init with autoStart:false, call app.render() in render(t).

capabilities.name: WebGL2 shaders (lib/gpu.js)
capabilities.bestFor: procedural gradients, distortion, glow with explicit uniforms
capabilities.note: Needs config.gpu: true (SwiftShader, deterministic, CPU).

capabilities.name: Three.js (browser 3D)
capabilities.bestFor: real 3D objects, materials, lights, orbiting cameras, glTF products
capabilities.note: import from 'three' / 'three/addons/…' (composer import map). Study: metallic bottle, PMREM room light, identical pixels across runs (2026-10-03). Needs config.gpu: true (software WebGL): keep scenes modest; heavy realism belongs to Blender.

capabilities.name: Rapier rigid-body bake (lib/physics.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: a box, a sphere and a stack baked once at 1/120 or 1/240, then sampled at any frame time
capabilities.avoidFor: a live step inside render(t) — films render frames out of order. Cloth, fluid and smoke stay on the Blender simulation route
capabilities.note: Import '@dimforge/rapier3d-compat' (composer import map). The -compat build inlines WASM. node studio.mjs setup physics. The study also needs setup gpu and config.gpu: true. If the package is missing, bake() is a labelled semi-implicit Euler preview, not a delivery.

capabilities.name: Playback review player (node studio.mjs review)

capabilities.note: Mixed Arabic/English recognised per phrase; word timing is estimated inside Whisper segments (not forced alignment); confidence is not provided by the decoder.

capabilities.name: Speech recognition + diarization (tools/live.py: Silero VAD, Whisper turbo, pyannote + ERes2Net)
capabilities.bestFor: offline Arabic/English/mixed transcription and who-speaks-when
capabilities.note: Models: python tools/live.py models --asr=turbo --tts=1 --diar=1. Test 2026-10-03: Arabic + English sentences both recognised with --lang=auto; diarization merged two similar synthetic male voices (2 of 3 speakers).

capabilities.name: Local Whisper captions (lib/whisper.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: one-step local captions from a video or audio file: whisper.cpp, then faster-whisper, then sherpa-onnx
capabilities.avoidFor: any cloud speech API — this path never calls one
capabilities.note: ready means lib/whisper.mjs is in the tree, not that a model is installed. node studio.mjs captions <file> exits 2 and prints install commands when no backend is ready. setup whisper does not download models (tiny 75 MiB through large-v3 2.9 GiB). Word times are real for whisper.cpp (-ojf) and faster-whisper (word_timestamps). sherpa-onnx stays proportional inside segments, and the transcript says so.

capabilities.name: Motion Canvas (isolated editor)
capabilities.bestFor: a short title and shape scene authored in the Motion Canvas editor (1920×1080 and 1080×1920 examples)
capabilities.avoidFor: unattended film builds — no package ships a headless CLI; config.engine prints the editor steps and exits 2
capabilities.note: Optional and isolated: studio/engines/motion-canvas, own package.json, not imported by the studio. Installed @motion-canvas/core, 2d, vite-plugin, ffmpeg and ui 3.17.2; each package.json and LICENSE file says MIT. Keep this exact pin. Before any upgrade, read each package's licence. Upstream main (motion-canvas/motion-canvas @ 7b91435) sets packages/ffmpeg to GPLv3, and that file's version string is also 3.17.2. A GPLv3 encoder is unusable for client work without a licence review. Do not replace the npm packages with a checkout of that commit. @motion-canvas/ui is extra because the editor imports it. vite 5.4.21. No bin. The renderer runs in the editor; @motion-canvas/ffmpeg encodes frames the browser sends over a websocket. One landscape render succeeded here by opening the Vite URL and pressing Render: output/landscape.mp4, 1920×1080, 1.47 s, 30 fps. The reel variant was not rendered. lib/engines.mjs motionCanvasEngine() is the external-engine shape; it does not render.

capabilities.name: Cover and title cards (Satori + resvg)
capabilities.bestFor: YouTube thumbnails, reel covers, square posts and 1920×1080 title cards from a small JSON spec
capabilities.avoidFor: a phrase Satori shapes badly — pass --renderer=chromium (lib/cdp.mjs). The cover-study Arabic phrase joined correctly
capabilities.note: satori@0.63.2 and @resvg/resvg-js@2.6.2, both MPL-2.0, used unmodified as libraries via node studio.mjs setup covers (studio/vendor, git-ignored). MPL file-level copyleft is not triggered: their source is not modified or copied into the studio. lib/covers.mjs builds a plain element tree (no JSX) and resvg writes the PNG. The looked-at Arabic PNG (examples/cover-study, بكسل بلس) had joined letters and a right-aligned layout, so Arabic stays on Satori. --renderer=chromium uses headless Chromium (lib/cdp.mjs), the same browser path as composer stills. No Chromium comparison was run.

capabilities.name: Interactive 3D anatomy explainer
capabilities.bestFor: a procedural object exploded into labelled parts (hover, tour, Arabic notes) that a film can also sample with render(t)
capabilities.license: MIT (three.js only; the geometry is original)
capabilities.note: web/explainers/anatomy. Parts come from parts.json. Three.js is the gpu profile, linked as engine/three so the page can load it. A flat diagram stays with diagram-design; a mesh rebuilt from a photo stays with img2threejs.
